title: Overview Prop book shows live prop equity, open trades and realized P&L
note: Operator 2026-10-10: Overview Prop view showed all dashes and 'No open prop trades' while velotrade_1 had an OPEN fill (id 96) and fresh equity on two accounts. ROOT CAUSE (SPA, not API): ExecSummary.svelte hard-coded the prop branch to equity=null, open=[] and segPerf=null ('lives on the Prop tab'); Overview never fetched any prop endpoint. FIX: API GET /api/bot/prop/overview (equity over fresh snapshots only, stale listed+excluded; open = open/filled with no closing row; realized over closed fills in window, population stated) + SPA wiring in ict-trader-dashboard. OBSERVATION THAT CLOSES: after the API deploys AND the SPA Pages build publishes, Overview > Prop > 7d shows the open velotrade_1 ETHUSDT long and total equity = sum of fresh accounts.

observation.what: Overview > Prop > 7d shows the open velotrade_1 ETHUSDT long and total equity equal to the sum of fresh prop accounts
observation.how_to_check: curl -s https://ict-bot.duckdns.org/api/bot/prop/overview?window=7d (open_trades non-empty, equity.total_usd = sum of counted accounts) then load the SPA Overview with Prop selected after both PRs (metis-insights #17421, ict-trader-dashboard #221) are deployed
